terms-and-conditions: These Terms & Conditions govern car-washing, interior cleaning, deep cleaning, polishing, detailing and related vehicle-care services supplied by Trifecta Car Washing & Polishing (“Trifecta”, “we”, “us”) in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. They apply to bookings made through our website, applications, telephone, WhatsApp, or our authorised employees. Please read them together with our Cancellation & Refund Policy, Service Warranty & Aftercare Policy, Privacy Policy, and Data Protection & Confidentiality Policy.

Before confirming an online booking, customers will be shown the selected service, applicable price, location, date and time, and a link to these terms. We request affirmative acceptance of the Terms & Conditions before submission. For telephone, messaging, or staff-assisted bookings, Trifecta will provide or link to the relevant conditions and record the booking confirmation. A booking is confirmed only when the system or Trifecta confirms it. We will inform customers of any material changes in availability.

Each package will identify its principal inclusions, exclusions and price in UAE dirhams (AED). The treatment, vehicle size, condition, unusual contamination, and requested extras may affect the quotation. No additional paid work will be performed without prior customer approval. Any applicable VAT will be disclosed correctly before payment, based on Trifecta’s tax-registration status. We will issue an invoice or appropriate transaction record in accordance with applicable law, with Arabic information where required. All online and offline payments must be made using Trifecta’s approved methods.

Please provide accurate contact, vehicle and location details and ensure reasonable access at the agreed time. See the Cancellation & Refund Policy for the timing, refund and fee rules. Online self-service generally closes 24 hours before the appointment. You can still contact Trifecta after it closes, and the online cutoff does not determine your refund or rescheduling rights. If we need to change or cancel your appointment, we will notify you, explain the available alternatives and provide any refund or other remedy required by law.

Before service, please disclose known problems that could affect safe cleaning or detailing, including loose trim, damaged paintwork, worn upholstery, electrical faults and previous repairs. Where appropriate, we may document the vehicle’s apparent condition using photographs, videos, or a checklist for operational and complaint-resolution purposes. Customers are asked to remove cash, valuables, personal documents and portable electronics. Trifecta will assess any allegation of damage, loss or negligence fairly. Any liability or rights that cannot be excluded by law remain in effect.

Results depend on vehicle materials, condition, previous repairs and existing contamination. Not every stain, odour, scratch, chip or blemish can be safely removed. Before work begins, we will explain material service limitations, foreseeable risks and relevant precautions where appropriate. We do not make misleading guarantees about cosmetic results. The customer should follow any applicable aftercare instructions.

Please report suspected damage, missing property, incomplete work or unsatisfactory service as soon as reasonably possible, ideally at handover or promptly after discovery, to help us investigate while evidence is available. Reports are not automatically rejected because they are made later. Customers may use the Customer Complaints page or contact Trifecta directly. We will consider available photographs, booking details, inspection records, and the customer’s explanation. Statutory consumer rights and remedies remain unaffected.

We use personal information for bookings, service delivery, support, transactions and other disclosed lawful purposes. Customer names, phone numbers, addresses, vehicle information and GPS data are confidential. A written service address is sufficient for staff-assisted bookings. GPS is optional. We do not sell personal data or provide it for unrelated third-party marketing. See the Privacy Policy and Data Protection & Confidentiality Policy for access, processors, retention and rights.

These terms are governed by applicable UAE federal law and relevant Abu Dhabi requirements. Any dispute may be referred to the competent consumer-protection authority or court as permitted by law. No provision of these terms restricts rights or remedies that cannot lawfully be waived.
cancellation-and-refund-policy: This policy explains cancellation, rescheduling, no-show and refund arrangements for appointments with Trifecta Car Washing & Polishing. The conditions must be disclosed before booking confirmation. They operate subject to UAE consumer-protection law and do not remove remedies required for services that are not supplied or are deficient.

For a voluntary cancellation more than 4 hours before the scheduled start, eligible amounts prepaid are ordinarily refunded in full. For a cancellation more than 2 hours and up to and including exactly 4 hours before the start, the ordinary arrangement is to refund 50% and retain 50% of the eligible amount actually prepaid, where disclosed in advance, lawful and proportionate. If only a deposit was paid, this percentage applies to the eligible prepaid deposit, rather than the full service price. For a cancellation exactly 2 hours or less before the start, prepaid amounts are ordinarily not refundable where that retention was disclosed, lawful and proportionate. This policy does not create an additional cancellation charge or liability beyond what was prepaid. These rules do not limit statutory remedies.

More than 2 hours before the appointment, rescheduling is free, subject to availability. Exactly 2 hours or less before the appointment, an AED 25 rescheduling fee may apply if disclosed before booking and permitted by law. We will explain any applicable fee and confirm the revised appointment details.

Online self-service cancellation and rescheduling generally close 24 hours before the appointment. After that, contact Trifecta by phone or email with your booking reference. The online cutoff is a technical restriction and does not by itself remove any refund, rescheduling or statutory entitlement.

If the customer is absent, the vehicle cannot be accessed, or the address is materially incorrect, Trifecta will attempt to contact the customer using the available details. Any fee retained will reflect disclosed terms, reasonable circumstances and applicable law. We will consider genuine emergencies and other exceptional circumstances fairly. A late cancellation or missed appointment does not remove rights arising from Trifecta’s own failure to provide the agreed service.

If Trifecta needs to change or cancel a booking, or cannot provide the agreed service, we will notify the customer as soon as reasonably practicable and explain available alternatives. We will provide any refund or other remedy required by law. A new appointment may be arranged with the customer’s agreement.

Where service is absent, incomplete, or not supplied as agreed, Trifecta will investigate and offer an appropriate remedy in accordance with UAE law. Depending on the circumstances, this may include proper re-performance or a full or partial refund. Personal preferences alone do not automatically establish a deficiency. We consider the advertised package and the service actually supplied. No term in this policy excludes non-waivable statutory rights.

Approved refunds are normally returned through the original payment method where practicable, unless another lawful arrangement is agreed. We will explain any available processing estimate once the refund is approved. The time for funds to appear can depend on the payment provider or bank.
service-warranty-and-aftercare: This policy applies to washing, interior cleaning, deep cleaning, polishing, paint-correction, protective treatments and related services supplied by Trifecta Car Washing & Polishing. We will perform the agreed service with reasonable care in accordance with the selected package, information given before the service, and applicable law.

Trifecta honours warranty and service-quality obligations for a reasonable period appropriate to the nature of the service, or a longer period expressly agreed with the customer, as applicable under UAE consumer-protection regulations. If service was not performed or was deficient, the customer may be entitled, according to the circumstances and applicable law, to correct re-performance or an appropriate full or partial refund. Any written product-specific or commercial warranty is additional to, and does not replace, statutory rights.

Exterior washing may not eliminate permanent water spots, bonded contamination or pre-existing surface damage. Interior cleaning cannot guarantee complete removal of set-in stains, odours, mould, discolouration or deteriorated materials, and drying times vary. Polishing or paint correction may improve appearance without safely removing every scratch, chip or defect. The results of coatings, sealants or other protective treatments depend on the product, condition of the surface, maintenance requirements and any written product warranty.

Trifecta will explain material foreseeable risks and appropriate precautions before performing an affected treatment where required. Customers should disclose known fragile, damaged or previously repaired components and follow any provided aftercare directions, such as drying or curing requirements. Where a vehicle presents a significant risk, we may recommend an alternative treatment or decline the affected work after explaining why.

Before-and-after photographs, inspection notes and other relevant evidence may be used to establish the vehicle’s visible condition and investigate complaints. Please report suspected damage or incomplete work as soon as reasonably possible, ideally at handover or shortly after discovery, and include the booking reference and supporting photographs if available. Reports made later will be considered in accordance with applicable law. A two-hour cut-off does not limit statutory rights.

Trifecta will examine the booking, selected package, service record, available evidence and customer explanation. We will communicate our outcome and any corrective action or refund required by applicable law. A stated limitation of cosmetic results is not an excuse for deficient service or negligence.
privacy-policy: Controller and scope

Trifecta Car Washing & Polishing (“Trifecta”) is responsible for deciding how customer information is used in connection with its website, booking system, staff-assisted appointments and vehicle-care services. This policy explains what information we collect, why we need it, how it is protected and what choices and rights customers have. We apply relevant UAE privacy law, including Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 where applicable.
Information collected

Depending on the service, we may collect the customer’s name, telephone number, email if supplied, written service address, optional GPS coordinates if specifically provided or enabled, booking and service history, vehicle make/model/type, service instructions, payment status and transaction references, customer communications, feedback and complaints, and relevant before-and-after vehicle records. Website technical data and cookies may also be processed where applicable. We seek only the information reasonably required for these purposes. Online booking asks for a written address and a map link. An address-based map link can be used without sharing device GPS. For employee-assisted bookings, a written address is sufficient and GPS is optional.
Purposes for using data

We use information to create and fulfil bookings, coordinate the assigned team and service location, and send confirmations, changes and essential notices. We also use it to process payments, issue invoices, respond to enquiries and resolve complaints and refund requests. We document the vehicle’s condition, protect the system against misuse, comply with lawful obligations and improve customer support and service quality. Internal improvement work should use aggregate or de-identified information where practical. Names, exact addresses and live or historical location details are not used for public promotion or sold for advertising. We also keep a record of booking policy acceptance or staff provision of the policies. Complaint reports can include photographs you choose to provide.
Lawful processing and choices

We process personal information based on the consent or other lawful grounds available under applicable UAE legislation, including where required to take steps requested by the customer, perform a service contract, meet legal obligations or protect legal rights. Where consent is the basis, we provide a clear choice and a way to withdraw it, subject to lawful limitations. Optional marketing is separate from booking terms and does not have to be accepted to obtain an unrelated service.
Confidentiality and authorised access

Customer names, phone numbers, written addresses, GPS data, booking history, service notes and vehicle information are treated as private information. Access is limited to people with a legitimate role-related need, such as the assigned service team for a booked visit or an authorised manager responding to a problem. We use appropriate technical and organisational safeguards and limit the information shown to employees. We do not sell, rent or publish identifiable customer data or use customer names, written addresses or precise locations for unrelated marketing.
Service providers and required disclosure

Operating an online booking and payment service can require carefully controlled processing by our infrastructure, hosting, authentication, payment, messaging, email, maps or customer-support providers. Such providers may process limited information on our behalf or for their own legally defined payment functions. We seek appropriate contractual and security arrangements. Information may also be disclosed to competent authorities, courts or advisers where lawfully necessary. A necessary provider may process information in its own systems.
Data location and international transfers

Our Supabase project’s primary region for the booking database, authentication and stored files is Frankfurt, Germany. We aim to minimise access and transfers outside the operational environment needed to provide our services. Hosting and service providers may involve storage or processing outside the UAE. Actual locations and permitted transfers depend on the providers in use. Where cross-border transfers occur, Trifecta will assess and apply the legal requirements and appropriate safeguards. Where Resend handles transactional email, it stores email data in the United States.
Photos, videos and location

Vehicle photographs and inspection records may be used for service performance, documentation and complaint handling. They are not to be published for social media, testimonials or advertisements without a separate lawful basis and necessary permissions. Employees should not download or share customer photos and locations outside authorised work channels. You can provide an address-based map link instead of using device GPS. When you share your precise location, we use it only to locate and deliver the booked service. When staff open a navigation link, the maps provider receives the written address or coordinates used for directions.
Retention and security

We keep data for no longer than reasonably necessary for the disclosed purpose, subject to lawful accounting, transaction, complaint, fraud-prevention or legal-claim requirements. Different records may have different retention periods. The staff app can temporarily cache job details on staff devices for operational access, including during connection interruptions. Access in the app is scoped by staff role and work assignment. We maintain account-security measures and review suspected unauthorised access or disclosure.
Individual rights

Subject to applicable law and exceptions, customers may request information about their data, access or correction, deletion or restriction, withdrawal of consent where applicable, and other rights established by law. We may verify identity before granting access or deletion to prevent unauthorised disclosure. Use the Trifecta contact details below for privacy requests.
Cookies, links and communications

Essential technical cookies may be used for the functioning and security of the service. Non-essential analytics or marketing technologies will be presented with any required choices and consent mechanisms. Third-party sites may have separate privacy terms. Customers may opt out of promotional messages without affecting necessary booking, payment or support communications.
Updates and contact

We may update this policy as our services, providers or legal obligations change. We will publish the current version and effective date and provide additional notice of material changes where required.
data-protection: Trifecta Car Washing & Polishing treats customer information as confidential business records. We collect information to deliver an agreed service, assist customers, maintain lawful records and improve customer-support quality. We do not sell or rent personal information, publish customer addresses or precise locations, or share identifiable booking details with other businesses for their unrelated marketing.

Personal information includes customer names, contact numbers, written addresses, GPS coordinates where given, booking history and linked vehicle records. Names and locations are personal data that Trifecta treats as strictly confidential. Whether they qualify as “sensitive personal data” depends on the specific legal definition. Employees must only use the minimum customer information needed for their assigned work.

Booking and customer information is restricted according to a person’s authorised role and work duties. Assigned employees may access the details needed to attend a wash. Managers and administrators may access additional records only for permitted operational, customer-support, complaint and compliance purposes. Internal improvement analysis should minimise identifying details. Information must not be copied into personal contact lists, shared chat groups or unauthorised devices.

We do not intentionally disclose customer information to unrelated third parties for advertising or commercial resale. Necessary hosting, booking, authentication, payment, email, messaging and maps suppliers may handle information to provide the contracted service, under suitable safeguards and applicable law. Required disclosures to authorities or for legal claims may also occur. Where we use external providers or transfers, the Privacy Policy explains this transparently.

You can use a written service address and an address-based map link for online bookings. Precise GPS coordinates will be requested or used only where helpful and authorised, and will not be mandatory merely to schedule a wash. Customer address or GPS data is used to attend or manage the appointment and must not be published, sold, used to track a customer beyond the service or displayed to unrelated employees. For bookings made with staff, a written address is sufficient.

Trifecta maintains proportionate access controls and security processes, seeks appropriate commitments from vendors and limits record retention to genuine operational or legal requirements. We investigate suspected misuse, erroneous disclosure or security incidents and make any notifications required by applicable law. Staff must promptly report any suspected compromise or inappropriate use of customer information to authorised management.

Customers may contact Trifecta for privacy questions, corrections or other data-rights requests. We may verify identity and may need to keep certain information when the law requires it or where a lawful claim is unresolved. This page explains our confidentiality commitments and should be read with the more detailed Privacy Policy.
complaints: Trifecta Car Washing & Polishing aims to address complaints about service quality, incomplete work, vehicle damage, missing items, bookings, pricing, payments, refunds, conduct or privacy in a fair and timely way.

Use the Customer Complaints Form below or contact Trifecta by email or phone. Please report an issue promptly after discovery so evidence can be preserved. We consider reports made later, and a two-hour deadline does not limit your legal rights.

Please include your name, a contact method, the nature of the complaint, and enough details for us to investigate. If available, provide the booking reference, service date, vehicle description, a short explanation, and relevant photographs. A booking reference and photographs should not be required where the customer does not have them. Do not upload identity documents, payment-card numbers or other unnecessary sensitive information.

Where contact details are supplied, we will acknowledge receipt and provide a complaint reference. We will check the relevant appointment, the agreed package, communications, evidence and applicable legal obligations, and may ask for further information. Trifecta will communicate the result and any proposed corrective action within a reasonable timeframe, taking account of complexity.

A suitable outcome may include an explanation, corrective work, re-performance, a lawful full or partial refund, or further investigation. If dissatisfied, the customer may ask for management review by contacting Trifecta with the complaint reference using the contact details below. This procedure does not limit statutory rights or the right to contact an appropriate authority.
For businesses within its jurisdiction, you can contact Abu Dhabi’s consumer-protection authority through the Abu Dhabi Government Contact Centre or use the authority’s official channels.

Complaints and evidence are used for assessment, customer support, service improvement, related recordkeeping and lawful dispute handling. They are accessible to authorised staff only, subject to the Privacy Policy and Data Protection & Confidentiality Policy. We do not publish the complaint or its identifying details as promotional content.
